_about: B5 batch glossary (concepts/subagents-and-delegation, concepts/jobs-workflow-goal-plan). Owner: B5 writer. Searched core.json, b2.json, b4.json first; subagent, job, workflow, goal and plan-mode already exist in core.json and are reused with {{term ...}}.

subagent-provider.short: A named backend registered on ctx.subagents. A caller picks one by name. Providers differ in whether the child keeps a session.
subagent-provider.long: Method presence selects the family. prepareContinuable() gives a local, durable child. A provider with only start() runs once ({{cite packages/subagent/subagent/src/types.ts:340-355}}).

tool-restriction.short: An allow or deny name list (or both) on the global tools that one scoped agent can see. ctx.tools.restrict() applies it.
tool-restriction.long: The type is ToolRestriction ({{cite packages/core/tools/src/contracts.ts:372-381}}). Several restrictions intersect. The scoped registrations of an agent stay visible ({{cite packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:158-189}}).
